subject: InventoryAI onboarding – DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@inventoryai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-27 09:12 -0700
Subject: InventoryAI onboarding – DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the InventoryAI pilot. To get you fully activated we need to complete a couple procurement and security checkpoints so the finance and legal teams can issue the PO and enable billing. Can you help us with the following items this week?

- Confirm you received our standard DPA and indicate any redlines. I attached the current Redwood_DPA_v3.2.pdf for reference.
- Access to your SOC 2 equivalent evidence or concurrence to rely on our SOC 2 summary link (we can share a limited-access report).
- Your current subprocessor roster (spreadsheet is easiest) and any in-scope data residency requirements.
- PO routing: confirm the procurement contact + billing address and any vendor setup form you require.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.2.pdf (attached), PO_Instructions_Redwood.pdf (attached)

Next steps from our side: Kimberly (cc) will route the PO once legal confirms the DPA status; Laura will add the onboarding checklist in our vendor portal and create the initial access. If you can send the subprocessor list as an attachment or link, that would speed things up.

Appreciate it — aiming to have you live by early July.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment stubs: Redwood_DPA_v3.2.pdf (PDF, 86KB), PO_Instructions_Redwood.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@inventoryai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@inventoryai.com>
Date: 2028-06-27 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: InventoryAI onboarding – DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path

Hi Marcus —

Thanks — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick updates from our side:

- We reviewed the DPA. A couple of small comments on retention wording and a data export clause; legal will send redlines by EOD tomorrow.
- We do not have a full SOC 2 report we can share, but we can consume your SOC2 summary page and provide a signed attestation if needed. Please send the limited-access link.
- Attached is our current subprocessor inventory (InventoryAI_Subprocessors_2028-06.xlsx). We highlight two new subprocessors (CloudRack and LogStream) — both are used only for metrics and logs.
- Procurement: billing_contact@inventoryai.com is our AP mailbox; billing address is 411 Techway, Suite 210, Seattle, WA 98101. We also have a vendor onboarding form (Vendor-Setup-InventoryAI.pdf) — procurement prefers a PO + Net30 term.

Attachments: InventoryAI_Subprocessors_2028-06.xlsx (attached)

Let me know if Redwood needs anything else to generate a PO.

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Partnerships
InventoryAI
sara.jenkins@inventoryai.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@inventoryai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28 08:25 -07:00
Subject: Re: InventoryAI onboarding – DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path

Hi Sara, Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Sara. Two operational notes from finance/legal:

1) Legal asked us to get the InventoryAI redlines back in a tracked PDF or DocuSign so we can log the contract change. If you can use our standard DocuSign envelope that’s quickest — I can initiate it today once Marcus confirms.

2) For the SOC 2 access: we can provision a time-limited report link if you prefer Redwood’s SOC2 summary. Marcus, can you attach the hosted summary link and the minimal-access instructions?

Sara — once we have redlines and your AP mailbox confirmed for purchase order issuance, I’ll route the PO (Net30). Please confirm the billing email for PO receipts — is that billing_contact@inventoryai.com?

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@inventoryai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-28 09:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: InventoryAI onboarding – DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path

Kimberly / Sara —

Link to Redwood SOC2 summary: https://status.redwood.com/soc2/summary-2028-q1 (limited-access token will be sent separately).

I’ve attached the SOC2 one-pager and the DPA copy earlier; I’ll start the DocuSign flow for the DPA redline acceptance unless InventoryAI prefers to upload tracked changes instead.

Laura — can you create the vendor record with the following fields so finance can issue the PO?
- Vendor name: InventoryAI
- AP email: billing_contact@inventoryai.com
- Billing address: 411 Techway, Suite 210, Seattle, WA 98101
- Tax ID: 91-2743890 (InventoryAI provided)

Sara — one question on subprocessors: do CloudRack or LogStream process any non-production customer data (e.g., user content)? If yes we’ll need a short data flow description for our GDPR in-scope mapping. If not, we’re fine with the roster you attached.

Marcus
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@inventoryai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@inventoryai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30 16:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: InventoryAI onboarding – DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO path

Marcus / Kimberly / Laura —

Quick follow-up: legal is sending the DPA redlines via DocuSign now (you should see the envelope). CloudRack and LogStream only process logs and anonymized metrics — they do not handle raw customer content. I’ve attached a one-paragraph data flow summary in the DocuSign comments and included our AP mailbox for PO issuance (billing_contact@inventoryai.com).

Procurement team — please issue the PO to billing_contact@inventoryai.com and confirm the PO number so we can map it to the implementation ticket. We expect to start provisioning next week once the PO is in place.

Thanks —
Sara
